title: Wedding picture and the missing Bolden band picture
summary: At Perdido Street she showed the picture; her wedding photo was lost; the Bolden band picture was given away and Bolden died in the asylum.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
